title: Mirror Panel Luxury Bed – Upholstered Bed Frame with Mirror Detail
descriptionHtml:
Mirror panels set into the headboard of the Mirror Panel Luxury Bed catch the light and add a glamorous touch. Premium upholstery surrounds them, and the bed is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Mirror panel detailing on the headboard
  • Premium padded fabric upholstery
  • Solid timber slatted frame
  • Free fabric swatches

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £454.99; Small Double (4FT) £519.99; Double (4FT6) £532.99; King (5FT) £584.99; Super King (6FT) £649.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a solid wood frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, and custom requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

We deliver free to addresses across Great Britain with our own delivery team, normally in 3-5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Returns are free within 14 days for unused, unassembled items in original packaging (we collect). Faulty items are replaced free or refunded in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

How is it different from the Mirror Strip Sunrise bed?

This bed has mirror panels on the headboard. The Mirror Strip Sunrise bed has a mirror strip within sunrise-style panels.

How do I look after the upholstery?

Our how to care for an upholstered bed and mattress covers upholstery care. Call 07417 439197 if you have a question about a specific fabric.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Not sure on colour? Order free fabric swatches and see the fabric at home before you buy.
